title: Practice: один, два, три, четыре in every case

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: She gave birth to twin girls.
exercises.why: Numerals are declined in Russian. They have their own pattern of declension. The number «ОДИН» acts as an adjective. It agrees with the nouns to which it refers in gender, number and case. ОДИН (ОДНА, ОДНО) declines like этот (ЭТА, ЭТО). — DLI, Lesson 70.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Numerals are declined in Russian. (DLI, Lesson 70)
